scientific_integrity: Reproducing-kernel normalization, finite rational recurrence, global tail estimate, and sharp condition ratio supplied; exact checker corroborates finite parts. All-degree claims follow from analytic estimates. Scientific priority remains subject to independent literature assessment.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to equiangular nine-line configurations in complex dimension three and phase-invariant equal bidegrees. Conditional on existence of a SIC (established); does not quantify robustness of physical measurements or infer publication priority.
title: A universal sharp conditioning law for projective harmonic interpolation on qutrit SICs
